memory_bridge: On リョク names ability, On リキ powers the sumo compound, and Kun ちから is the native standalone word for strength.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 能力（のうりょく）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The hooked arm proves what it can do on an ability gauge labeled 能力（のうりょく）; the power character carries On リョク there.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 力士（りきし）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Ricky the sumo wrestler flexes the hooked arm before entering the ring: Ricky → リキ in 力士（りきし）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 力（ちから）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Strip away the uniform and title; the raw force in the flexing arm itself is 力（ちから）, native ‘strength; power.’
